name: SkyRL
tagline: A modular full-stack RL library for LLMs
description: SkyRL is a modular, full-stack reinforcement learning library for LLMs from NovaSky (the team behind the Sky-T1 open reasoning model). It covers the whole RL pipeline — from data and reward design to training, evaluation, and deployment — in one coherent framework, with documentation to match. For teams training reasoning and RL-tuned models, it is a credible open alternative to sprawling in-house stacks.
highlights: End-to-end RL for LLMs: data, rewards, training, eval, deployment
From NovaSky, the Sky-T1 open reasoning model team
Modular design with real documentation at docs.skyrl.ai
2.1k stars and a proven lineage in open RL
curatorNote: Open RL for LLMs is still young, and most of it is fragmented scripts. SkyRL is the rare full-stack, documented take — from the team that already proved itself with Sky-T1.
